data.one_liner: Restrict screen capture and recording on mobile and monitor events.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to block screen capture and recording, resulting in blacked-out media on mobile platforms. It also provides listeners to detect when screen captures or screen recordings occur.
use_when: You need to prevent users from recording or taking screenshots of sensitive screens.
You need to detect and monitor screen captures or recordings within your app.
avoid_when: You do not need native mobile screen restriction features.
You want to avoid requesting sensitive storage permissions like MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE on Android.
strengths: Provides both restriction and detection capabilities for mobile platforms.
Migrated to Pigeon for type safety.
weaknesses: Requires sensitive Android permissions for full detection functionality on certain SDK versions.
Known delays in callbacks on specific Android versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires requesting appropriate storage permissions in AndroidManifest.xml depending on the Android SDK version.
